[GENERATED IMPLEMENTATION]
let rec loop (num: Rat) : Rat :=
  if num < 1 then
    num
  else
    loop (num - num.floor)
loop number
[END]
[HELPER LEMMAS]
lemma floor_nonneg (n: Rat)
: 0 ≤ n.floor :=
by
rw [Rat.floor]
have h_0_le_n: 0 ≤ n := by
  apply Rat.floor_le_self
  linarith
simp [h_0_le_n]
[END]
[PROOF]
by
unfold problem_spec
let result := implementation number
use result
simp [result]
simp [implementation]
intro h_pos
have h_0_le_num: 0 ≤ number := by
  linarith
have h_0_le_res := floor_nonneg number
by_cases h_res_lt_1: result < 1
-- Case 1: result < 1
simp [h_res_lt_1]
apply And.intro
linarith
apply And.intro
intro h_num_floor_res
simp [h_num_floor_res]
linarith
-- Case 2: result ≥ 1
have h_1_le_res: 1 ≤ result := by
  linarith
rw [Rat.floor_eq_of_le]
simp [h_pos]
rw [←Rat.floor_add]
simp [h_pos]
have h_num_floor_res: number.floor + result = number := by
  simp [h_num_floor_res]
linarith
have h_res_eq_num_floor: result = number.floor := by
  simp [h_num_floor_res]
simp [h_res_eq_num_floor]
have h_num_lt_1: number < 1 := by
  linarith
have h_num_le_0: number ≤ 0 := by
  linarith
have h_num_eq_0: number = 0 := by
  linarith
have h_num_eq_0': number.floor = 0 := by
  simp [h_num_eq_0]
simp [h_num_eq_0']
simp [h_num_eq_0]
have h_res_eq_0: result = 0 := by
  simp [h_num_eq_0']
have h_res_le_0: 0 ≤ result := by
  simp [h_res_eq_0]
have h_res_ge_0: result ≥ 0 := by
  simp [h_res_eq_0]
linarith
[END]
